title: Microsoft Teams: Tenant policy controls who can record and transcribe
description: Teams administrators can use meeting policies to control who can start recording and transcription, helping organizations apply consistent meeting settings. Administrators can restrict these permissions to organizers and co-organizers or extend them to presenters. They can also determine whether meeting organizers can modify these settings or whether they are enforced by policy.
